NetworkComparison: differential network analysis result

Source: R/AllClasses.R
NetworkComparison-class.Rd

Stores results from run_comparative_network, including differential, shared, and cell-type-specific edges. Use the accessors in network-accessors to extract them.

Usage

# S4 method for class 'NetworkComparison'
show(object)

Arguments

object

A NetworkComparison object.

Value

The show method prints a summary and returns NULL invisibly.

Slots

diff_edges

DataFrame. Edges present in some but not all of the compared networks (including edges unique to one cell type), with the range of their partial correlations.

shared_edges

DataFrame. Edges present in all compared cell types.

celltype_specific

Named list of DataFrames. Edges unique to each cell type.

summary

List. Summary statistics: Jaccard similarity, edge counts, cell types compared.

See also

network-accessors, NetworkComparison

Examples

showClass("NetworkComparison")
#> Class "NetworkComparison" [package "exposomeSC"]
#> 
#> Slots:
#>                                                                               
#> Name:         diff_edges      shared_edges celltype_specific           summary
#> Class:         DataFrame         DataFrame              list              list
